history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration complete the exercise of aligning Umoja objects of expenditure with budget objects of expenditure within a reasonable time frame.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Administration’s work on the alignment of Umoja objects of expenditure with budget objects of expenditure, the misalignment of which was largely attributable to the use of legacy classifications during the transition period, has been completed. In its report (A/75/5 (Vol. I)), the Board had referred to the following: “The Administration stated that the biennial budget for 2018–2019 had been prepared using the old budget system (Integrated Management Information System), which had different commitment items, and that the preparation of the 2020 budget in the business planning and consolidation module using Umoja commitment items had facilitated the further alignment of budgets in 2020. As the Organization gained more experience with budget implementation in Umoja, it was anticipated that, in 2020, there should be fewer related variances resulting from alignment.” With the preparation of the proposed programme budget for 2027, the Secretariat is now in its seventh year of preparing and implementing annual budgets. In this context, the misalignment between Umoja objects of expenditure and budget objects of expenditure observed in earlier periods has been resolved.
history.board_assessment: Given that the alignment has been completed, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
